desc: Sheldon walks up and picks up a brown package that was sitting next to the apartment door.
Sheldon, standing next to Leonard, in front of their doors, jumps up and down happily holding a cardboard box.
Sheldon stands in the hallway with Leonard, holding a cardboard box and covering his mouth.
While Penny, Amy, and Bernadette, are unboxing something, Leonard knocks on Penny's opened door .
Sheldon stands in the hallway talking to a Spock cutout.
Amy and Bernadette are sitting on Penny's bed on a pile of clothes when Penny comes out of her bathroom in a green dress.
Penny comes out of her bathroom in a grey vest on brown shirt, while Amy and Bernadette are sitting on Penny's bed on a pile of clothes.
Bernadette, sitting on the bed full of clothes next to Amy, stands and runs up to grab Penny's arm to lift her up from the armchair.
Penny, while sitting in a green armchair, puts her hands up to the sides of her face.
Sheldon takes two cards from his hand and shows them to laughing Raj and Howard while playing a board game at the glass table.
Leonard, in a black suit, is looking at his computer while talking to his friends, who are playing a board game at the glass table.
A shot of Sheldon rolling dice and pulling a car from the pile, near the board game set up on the glass table.
Howard puts his arm on his belly and bends over in his chair laughing, while holding cards in his hand.
Penny laughs and fixes her bangs while holding a glass of wine, at the restaurant with Leonard, in black suit.
Sheldon lays down some cards in a couple of places on the table while playing a card game with bored Raj and Howard.
Leonard, in a black suit, comes into the apartment and slams the door, then Howard looks at his watch.
Sheldon places a blue game piece on the game board while Raj and Howard laugh.
Leonard rolls over in bed, with a blue cover, and puts his glasses on to check his phone.
Leonard, in a red robe, standing in the hallway in front of the doors, gets kissed by Penny.
Penny stops kissing Leonard, in a red robe, and leads him by the hand from his doorway to her apartment.
Leonard rolls onto his side toward Penny, while they are lying together in bed on orange pillows.
Penny, while lying in bed with orange pillows, gets Leonard's inhaler from her bedroom side table drawer and hands it to him.
Leonard shakes and holds the inhaler up to his mouth while lying in bed with Penny on orange pillows.
Leonard, in a red robe, sneaks into the apartment just as Sheldon turns on the light.
Leonard pulls his inhaler out of his red robe pocket and happily holds it up in the air.
Sheldon picks up some money from his desk drawer while Leonard stands in the back, in a red robe, with an inhaler in his hand.
Leonard, in a red robe, looks at the ground and blinks a couple of times, then takes the money from Sheldon's hand.
Leonard, at night in bed, rubs his head, then wakes up, puts on his glasses, and looks at his phone.
Penny yells and gestures a lot with her hands, angry at Leonard, in a red robe, while standing in the hallway at his door.
Leonard, in a red robe, walks away from Penny, stands in front of Penny's open door, yells, and gestures with his hand for her to go in.
Sheldon folds up the cardboard version of Spock.
Penny and Leonard stand at the altar, and as they turn to face each other, Penny reveals a big pregnant belly.
